profile_text.body:
Dropbox is a for-profit public company founded in 2007 and headquartered in San Francisco, CA. It offers secure cloud storage, file sharing, and collaboration tools, and describes itself as providing easy cloud storage for file sharing and collaboration. The company also offers Dash, which it positions as a way to save time and organize company content in one place. Dropbox trades on a public exchange under the ticker DBX and reported revenue of $2,521,000,000 for the period ending 2025-12-31, per its 10-K filing.

On the AI side, Dropbox offers a product called Dropbox AI, categorized under notes, knowledge, and meetings, which covers cloud storage AI, document summaries, team data, and sharing controls. The company is also present in the Model Context Protocol ecosystem through a third-party MCP server, ai.smithery/cindyloo-dropbox-mcp-server, which enables users to search, browse, and read Dropbox files, find documents by name or content, and list folders.
